title_zh: 细胞治疗
title_en: Cell Therapy
desc_zh: 面向免疫细胞治疗与干细胞治疗的临床转化研究，优化细胞治疗产品制备工艺，推动从实验室到临床的转化。
desc_en: Translational research on immune cell and stem cell therapy, optimizing manufacturing processes to advance bench-to-bedside translation.
tags_zh: 免疫治疗,基因编辑,转化医学,工艺开发
tags_en: Immunotherapy,Gene Editing,Translational,Manufacturing

sort: 1
icon: 🐣
title_zh: 早期胚胎发育
title_en: Early Embryonic Development
desc_zh: 研究哺乳动物早期胚胎发育过程中的细胞命运决定与基因调控网络，解析合子基因组激活、谱系分化与X染色体失活等关键发育事件的分子机制。
desc_en: Studying cell fate determination and gene regulatory networks in early mammalian embryonic development, dissecting zygotic genome activation, lineage specification, and X chromosome inactivation.
tags_zh: 胚胎,合子基因组激活,谱系分化,X染色体失活
tags_en: Embryo,ZGA,Lineage,XCI
---

sort: 2
icon: 🧫
title_zh: 胚胎干细胞
title_en: Embryonic Stem Cells
desc_zh: 探索胚胎干细胞的干性维持与定向分化机制，刻画干细胞状态转换、表观遗传重编程以及向特定谱系分化的调控网络。
desc_en: Exploring pluripotency maintenance and directed differentiation of embryonic stem cells, characterizing state transitions, epigenetic reprogramming, and lineage-specific regulatory networks.
tags_zh: 胚胎干细胞,多能性,分化,表观遗传
tags_en: ESC,Pluripotency,Differentiation,Epigenetics

icon: 🔬
title_zh: 不孕不育
title_en: Infertility
desc_zh: 从遗传学、表观遗传学与细胞生物学角度系统研究不孕不育的发病机制，为临床诊断与精准治疗提供生物标志物与干预靶点。
desc_en: Systematically studying infertility pathogenesis from genetic, epigenetic, and cellular biology perspectives, providing biomarkers and intervention targets for clinical diagnosis and precision treatment.
tags_zh: 配子发生,胚胎阻滞,生物标志物,临床

title_zh: 再生医学
title_en: Regenerative Medicine
desc_zh: 利用干细胞与类器官技术研究组织器官再生机制，构建体外类器官模型，开发面向组织损伤修复与功能重建的再生医学策略。
desc_en: Utilizing stem cell and organoid technology to study tissue regeneration, constructing in vitro organoid models to develop regenerative strategies for injury repair and functional restoration.

title_zh: 生殖衰老
title_en: Reproductive Aging
desc_zh: 聚焦生殖细胞与生殖器官的衰老过程，解析卵母细胞老化与卵巢功能衰退的分子机制，探索延缓生殖衰老的干预策略。
desc_en: Focusing on germ cell and reproductive organ aging, dissecting molecular mechanisms of oocyte aging and ovarian function decline, exploring intervention strategies to delay reproductive aging.
tags_zh: 卵母细胞,卵巢,表观遗传,线粒体
